description: A step in connecting an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: name the address in opencode.json, with no key and no models map yet.

steps.description: This provider block holds only the address. It is step 2 of the page's route for connecting a hosted, OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
The provider ID is `myendpoint`, a placeholder. The page says to pick a short ID and type the same word again in step 3.
`options.baseURL` is `https://YOUR-ENDPOINT/api/v1`, a placeholder address. There is no key and no `models` map here, because the plugin fills the models in on the next start.

steps.question: The plugin fills the models map in from the endpoint. Where does the key come from in this route?

title: A Provider Block with Address Only
